mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary policy easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% indicates labor market deterioration, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve tightens policy, increasing equity discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing sector contraction, signaling economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline from prior period
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 600,000 million dollars), strong retail sales support corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS > 600,000.
